notify.welcomeBody: Pick a career goal to get a personalized learning plan and matching jobs.

welcome.title: Let's build your career profile
welcome.subtitle: We'll use this information to personalize your learning plan and match you with the right job opportunities.
welcome.uploadBody: Have a resume ready? Upload it and we'll extract your skills, education, and experience automatically.
welcome.chatBody: No CV yet? Answer a few quick questions and we'll build your profile together in a guided conversation.

upload.title: Upload your CV
upload.description: We'll analyze your resume to pre-fill your career profile.
upload.dropHere: Drag and drop your resume here
upload.supports: Supports PDF, DOC, DOCX, and TXT files. Your file stays on your device.

extracting.projectDesc: Edit this entry to describe your project.

chat.title: Tell us about yourself
chat.description: A quick chat helps us understand your background.
chat.done: Great, thanks! Let's review what you shared.

name.prompt: Hi! I'm your career assistant. What should I call you?

school.prompt: Nice to meet you! Which school are you attending?

degree.prompt: Which degree are you working toward?

skills.prompt: What are your top skills? List a few separated by commas.

coursework.prompt: Which relevant courses have you taken? (comma-separated)

review.title: Review your profile
review.description: Confirm or fix anything we got wrong, then continue to your dashboard.
